title: AI Infrastructure Protocol — blueprint (Gate 1 contract, to-be model + ranked backlog)
description: Output of G1 BLUEPRINT. For EVERY process in company-scan.json it records a disposition (keep-human / augment-ai / fully-automate) under a default-to-automate rule, names the concrete artifact that delivers each augment/automate, and produces a build backlog ranked by impact × effort with an ai_involvement_score per item. Gate 1 validates .protocol/blueprint.json against this schema. Gate 1 green requires: every scanned process id present exactly once in dispositions[]; every 'keep-human' carrying a justification; every 'augment-ai'/'fully-automate' naming an artifact; and every artifact appearing as a backlog item with a rank and an ai_involvement_score.

scanRef.description: Path/hash of the company-scan.json this blueprint was derived from. Ties the to-be model to the exact as-is map it answers.

operatingModel.description: One-paragraph narrative of the target AI operating model: what the company looks like once built, where humans sit, where AI runs the line.

dispositions.description: One disposition per scanned process. Exactly one entry per processId in the scan — no gaps, no duplicates. This is the core decision surface of the whole product.

processId.description: Must match a process id from company-scan.json.

disposition.description: Default-to-automate rule: choose fully-automate unless a decision/judgement/relationship/liability reason forces augment-ai, and keep-human only when a documented constraint forbids AI entirely.

rationale.description: Why this disposition. For keep-human this is a REQUIRED justification against the default (regulatory, relationship, safety, irreducible judgement) — 'we prefer a person' is not sufficient.

humanOnlyReason.description: REQUIRED whenever disposition = keep-human. Encodes which exception to the automate-default applies. Absence on a keep-human is a Gate 1 red.

artifacts.description: The concrete thing(s) that deliver this disposition. REQUIRED (minItems 1) whenever disposition is augment-ai or fully-automate; empty/absent for keep-human. Each artifact id must also appear in backlog[].artifactId.

kind.description: What gets built. 'app' routes to G2 → Pillar ① (3day-protocol four-gate engine). 'agent'/'automation'/'workflow'/'integration'/'knowledge-base' route to G2 → Pillar ③ agent factory.

delivers.description: The outcome it produces in one line (e.g. 'auto-drafts and routes invoice approvals, escalates >€5k to a human').

replacesSteps.description: Which scan step orders this artifact absorbs (from the process's steps[].order). Makes the before/after auditable.

buildsOnSkill.description: Bundled skills the operator composes to build this (e.g. 'agent-browser', 'composio-cli', 'supabase', 'whatsapp-ai-agent'). Reuse before build.

dataSensitivity.description: Highest sensitivity of data this artifact touches (carried from scan). Drives how hard Pillar ⑤ Security must lean on it at G3.

backlog.description: The build backlog: one item per artifact named in dispositions[], ranked. G2 consumes this — items marked sprint:'this' are built first.

rank.description: 1 = build first. Must be unique and dense (1..N) across the backlog.

impact.description: Impact is not a vibe. It is derived from scan volume × hours × pain severity. hoursSavedPerMonth must trace back to the scanned hours for this process.

score.description: 1=marginal, 5=transformational. Anchored by hoursSavedPerMonth and pain severity, not gut.

eurSavedPerMonth.description: hoursSavedPerMonth × loadedHourlyCost from the scan, if cost was captured. Feeds G4.

blockers.description: e.g. 'tool has no API', 'needs client OAuth', 'egress-blocked host'.

priorityScore.description: Ranking key = impact.score / effort.score (higher = do first). Recorded explicitly so the rank order is reproducible and auditable, not asserted.

ai_involvement_score.description: How much of this process AI runs once the artifact ships: 0 = purely human, 100 = zero-human-touch autonomous. fully-automate targets ≥80; augment-ai typically 40-79; keep-human items do not appear in the backlog. This is the objective-function metric the whole product optimizes and the headline number G4 sells.

sprint.description: 'this' = build now (Gate 2 checks all 'this' items are built+registered+green). 'next'/'later' = staged.

securityTier.description: How hard Pillar ⑤ must lean on it at G3, derived from dataSensitivity + autonomy. 'critical' = regulated data and/or high autonomy.

coverage.description: Self-checking counts. Gate 1 cross-validates: dispositionsCount must equal the number of processes in the scan, and every augment/automate disposition must have produced a backlog item.

aiInvolvement.description: Rollup of the objective function. The before/after AI-involvement of the whole company — the single number the engagement is judged on and the thesis line G4 leads with.

asIsPercent.description: Weighted AI involvement across all processes today (usually near 0).

toBePercent.description: Weighted AI involvement once the backlog ships. Weighted by process hours so it reflects where the work actually is, not process count.

method.description: One line: how the weighting was computed (e.g. 'sum(process_hours × ai_involvement_score) / sum(process_hours)').
